title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer must correctly state the hyperfine splitting energy as 10^{-5} eV.

title: Correct Formula
description: Important Criteria: The student must use the correct formula for energy, Delta E = h * nu.

title: Numerical Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the energy using the given frequency value.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculation.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as incorrect multiplication or unit conversion mistakes.
